title: Understanding the Stratification
text: Oski stratifies the sample based on high school location. This means the sample should reflect the proportions of attendees from each location.

title: Proportion of Attendees from California
text: Remember that Southern and Northern California are both part of California. Combine these two groups to find the total number of attendees from California.

title: Calculate Total California Attendees
text: Add the number of attendees from Southern California and Northern California to find the total number of attendees from California.

title: Calculate Sample Proportion
text: Calculate the proportion of attendees from California in the total attendee list. Use this proportion to find how many of the $$100$$ sampled email addresses are from California.
